name: HostArmada
tagline: Cloud SSD shared hosting on cPanel with a 45-day money-back guarantee
description: HostArmada is a cloud-based hosting provider offering shared, WordPress, VPS and dedicated hosting on cPanel, built on NVMe SSD storage across nine global data centers, with a longer-than-average 45-day money-back guarantee on shared plans.
about: HostArmada's shared hosting comes in three tiers: Start Dock (1 website, 15GB NVMe SSD storage), Web Warp (unlimited websites, 30GB NVMe SSD storage), and Speed Reaper (unlimited websites, 40GB NVMe SSD storage, plus LiteSpeed web server for faster page loads). All three run on standard cPanel, include free SSL, a free domain for the first year, daily backups and Cloudflare CDN compatibility.

The lowest advertised prices require a 3-year upfront term — longer than the 1-2 year commitments most competitors ask for — starting around $1.99/month (Start Dock), $3.29/month (Web Warp) and $3.95/month (Speed Reaper). Renewal pricing jumps substantially once that term ends, to roughly $9.95, $16.45 and $19.75 per month respectively, so the real multi-year cost is much higher than the headline rate suggests.
policies: HostArmada backs shared, reseller and VPS hosting with a 45-day money-back guarantee on the initial order — longer than the industry-standard 30 days. Dedicated CPU servers carry a shorter 7-day window, and renewal payments, monthly billing and domain fees are excluded from refunds.

faqs.a: Yes — all HostArmada shared hosting plans run on the standard cPanel control panel rather than a custom dashboard, so the interface will feel familiar if you've used cPanel with another host before.

faqs.q: How long is HostArmada's money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: 45 days on shared, reseller and VPS hosting — longer than the typical 30-day window most hosts offer. Dedicated CPU servers only get 7 days, and the guarantee covers initial orders only, not renewals.

faqs.q: Is HostArmada's lowest price locked in for renewal?
faqs.a: No. The cheapest advertised rates require paying for a full 3-year term upfront, and renew at a noticeably higher monthly rate afterward — check the renewal price for your specific plan before committing to the longest term.
